assessments.mechanism: Preserve historical-best checkpoints independently of exploratory continuation; final/deployment selection need not equal the last attempt.
assessments.clean_scope: RSIBench-Data trajectories show later regression is common; descriptive 24-setting evidence, not a universal causal law.
assessments.o_comparison: O has immutable invocation/history, reversible Candidate states and a direct bounded-stage checkpoint-inheritance experiment. That exact O experiment tested width-1 versus width-3 sibling checkpoints on three frozen tasks and rejected the tested adaptation because model invocations rose 1.0→3.0 despite a 0.827209s median wall-time improvement. It did not test longitudinal non-monotone historical-best preservation as in RSIBench, so the clean candidate is only partially tested. The rejection is not evidence against the original family.

assessments.mechanism: Distill reusable procedural skills from heterogeneous multi-model traces rather than one model's experience.
assessments.clean_scope: AFTER enterprise-task transfer evidence; public repo confirms task/evaluation structure but not every experiment table.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly seeks heterogeneous methods and persists reusable Episodes/Candidates, but has no multi-model trace-pool procedural distillation or held-out cross-model transfer experiment.

assessments.mechanism: Gate skill injection by model × scaffold × domain compatibility, preserve a vanilla/base fallback, and track negative transfer.
assessments.clean_scope: EvoAgentBench cells show large method×scaffold×model interactions; leaderboard means lack site-level standard errors and do not justify blanket rejection of any method.
assessments.o_comparison: O Candidates are exact-scope, reversible, evaluated against protected baselines, and remain inactive/untested outside accepted scope; the active component is the fallback when a Candidate is rejected. O has not learned or evaluated a model×scaffold×domain skill router on EvoAgentBench-like held-out cells.

assessments.mechanism: Explicit persistent-state consultation/render/route/gate/closeout stages, with retrieval-before-action and authoritative closeout.
assessments.clean_scope: PAST-Bench aggregate gains are noisy and capability interactions are strong; mechanism-level diagnosis is stronger than a universal headline win.
assessments.o_comparison: O's Context Kernel already performs authoritative source consultation, typed rendering, optional routing, action binding/recheck, and durable receipt/closeout. It has not separately ablated PAST-style retrieval gate/closeout components for task-level persistence gains.
